duration.quote: applicants who have completed a baccalaureate degree must complete two years of relevant professional experience; applicants who have completed a post-baccalaureate degree, or a baccalaureate degree with at least one hundred fifty total semester credit hours, must complete one year of relevant experience

kind.value: relevant professional experience in accounting, attestation, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting
kind.quote: providing a service or advice in one or more of the following areas: accounting; attestation; compilation; management advisory; financial advisory; tax; consulting skills

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.quote: evidence of a passing score on a standardized test of accounting knowledge, skills, and abilities approved by the board and substantially equivalent to the Uniform CPA Examination

exams.name: Professional Ethics Examination
exams.quote: evidence of a passing score on an examination in professional ethics as approved by the board

interval_years.quote: Renewal due date" is February first of a licensing year

required.quote: A licensee shall document forty hours of continuing professional education that is acceptable to the board, completed during the immediately preceding calendar year

hours_per_period.quote: forty hours of continuing professional education that is acceptable to the board, completed during the immediately preceding calendar year

period_years.quote: completed during the immediately preceding calendar year

topical_requirements.quote: An annual ethics requirement must be met and included in the documented hours of continuing professional education. No less than two hours of the annual forty hours of continuing professional education must relate to ethics

available.quote: A CPA licensed in another jurisdiction who moves his principal place of business to this State may obtain a license through reciprocity

requirements.value: Must have passed Uniform CPA Examination, hold active license in another jurisdiction, be legally authorized to practice there, and certify compliance with continuing education requirements
requirements.quote: has successfully passed the Uniform CPA Examination; holds an active certificate, license, or permit issued pursuant to the laws of any state or territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or any foreign licensing authority that is recognized by the International Qualifications Appraisal Board and subject to Mutual Recognition Agreements; is legally authorized to practice in the jurisdiction where his existing certificate, license, or permit is held; and certifies that he is in compliance with the continuing professional education requirements in the jurisdiction where his existing certificate, license, or permit is held

exists.quote: Board" means the South Carolina Board of Accountancy

national_association.quote: AICPA" means the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or successor organizations

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in the practice of accountancy as regulated by this board without holding a valid license or registration

credential_type.quote: License" means authorization to practice as issued under this chapter

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in the practice of accountancy as regulated by this board without holding a valid license or registration

title_protection.quote: Only a person holding a valid license as a certified public accountant or qualifying for a practice privilege under Section 40-2-245 shall use or assume the title "Certified Public Accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA"

scope_protection.quote: Only licensed certified public accountants or public accountants or individuals qualifying for a practice privilege pursuant to Section 40-2-245 may issue a report on financial statements of a person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offer to render or render any attest or compilation service

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony with element of dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony that has an element of dishonesty or fraud or any other crime that has an element of dishonesty or fraud

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct reflecting adversely upon fitness to perform services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services as a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or forged statement in obtaining licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of a false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document or committal of a fraudulent, deceitful, or dishonest act or omission of a material fact in obtaining licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional use of false or fraudulent statement in document connected with practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentional use of a false or fraudulent statement in a document connected with the practice of the individual's profession or occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining fees or assistance in obtaining fees under fraudulent circumstances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining fees or assistance in obtaining fees under fraudulent circumstances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with established professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with established professional standards, including standards set by federal or state law or regulation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of code of professional ethics or AICPA Professional Standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of the code of professional ethics adopted by the board or of the AICPA Professional Standards: Code of Professional Conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to respond to requests for information or cooperate in investigations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to respond to requests for information or to cooperate in investigations on behalf of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engagement or aid of another in unlicensed practice of accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engagement or aid of another, intentionally or knowingly, directly or indirectly, in unlicensed practice of accounting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to disclose or disclaim appropriate license status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to disclose or disclaim the appropriate license status of a person or entity not holding a license but associated with financial statements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engagement in false, misleading, or deceptive advertising or solicitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engagement in advertising or other forms of solicitation or use of a firm name in a manner that is false, misleading, deceptive, or tending to promote unsupported claims

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other discipline by another state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the revocation, suspension, reprimand, or other discipline of the right to practice by the licensee in any other state or by a federal agency for a cause other than the failure to pay an annual registration fee

definition_quote.value: issuing a report on financial statements of a person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offering to render or rendering any attest or compilation service
definition_quote.quote: issuing a report on financial statements of a person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offering to render or rendering any attest or compilation service

methods_authorized.quote: any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); any engagement to be performed in accordance with Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) Auditing Standards; or any examination, review, or agreed upon procedure to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

value: examination, review, or agreed upon procedure
attest_services_types.quote: any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); any engagement to be performed in accordance with Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) Auditing Standards; or any examination, review, or agreed upon procedure to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Compilation" means providing a service of any compilation engagement to be performed in accordance with SSARS

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: at least one hundred twenty semester hours of credit

ethics_exam_required.quote: evidence of a passing score on an examination in professional ethics as approved by the board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: No notice, fee, or other submission is required for the individual to practice pursuant to these privileges

value: consents to personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the board
agrees to comply with regulations and provisions
agrees to cease offering or rendering professional services if license from principal jurisdiction is no longer valid
consents to service of administrative notice at the board in principal jurisdiction
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: consents to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the board and its disciplinary authority; agrees to comply with the regulations and provisions of this section; agrees to cease offering or rendering professional services in this State, individually or on behalf of a firm, if their license, permit, or certificate from his principal jurisdiction is no longer valid; consents to service of an administrative notice of hearing at the board in the individual's principal jurisdiction

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: a firm with an office in this State performing attest services as defined in Section 40-2-20(2) or engaging in the practice of accounting

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: A simple majority of the firm ownership in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers must belong to certified public accountants currently licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Although firm ownership may include non-CPA owners, the firm and its owners must comply with regulations promulgated by the board

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: As a condition of renewal of registration, an applicant who engages in attest or compilation services, or both, must provide evidence of satisfactory completion of peer review

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: no more frequently than once every three years

retired_license_status_available.quote: A licensee may apply to the board for permission to place the word "Retired" adjacent to his "Certified Public Accountant" title

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: Firms that do not have an office in this State may engage in the practice of accounting, without obtaining a registration pursuant to Section 40-2-40, as specified in this subsection

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: there must be a designated resident manager in charge of each office in this State who must be a certified public accountant licensed in this State

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: individuals in the firm, who are responsible for supervising attest or compilation services, or both, and who sign or authorize someone to sign the accountant's report on the financial statements on behalf of the firm, meet the competency requirements set out in the professional standards

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: a licensee under this chapter must not voluntarily disclose information communicated by the client relating to and in connection with services rendered. This information is confidential

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: CPA-prepared records and CPA work papers created by a licensee or on behalf of a registrant, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client, except the reports submitted by the licensee to the client and except for CPA work product, are and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an expressed agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: issue safe harbor language nonlicensees may use in connection with financial statements, transmittals, or financial information which does not purport to be in compliance with the SSARS

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: This section does not apply to a person or firm holding a certification, designation, degree, or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in that country; whose activities in this State are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of, or business entities of the country in which the person holds the entitlement

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: A firm that falls out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel, after receiving or renewing a permit, shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take this corrective action

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: a firm with an office in this State performing attest services as defined in Section 40-2-20(2) or engaging in the practice of accounting

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: The South Carolina Board of Accountancy shall examine, license, and discipline accounting practitioners

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: A licensee who is retired and does not perform or offer to perform for compensation one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including issuance of reports on financial statements or of one or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters, may apply to the board for permission to place the word "Emeritus" adjacent to the licensee's "Certified Public Accountant" title

ethics_cpe_hours_required.quote: No less than two hours of the annual forty hours of continuing professional education must relate to ethics

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice, the following documents with respect to the client or former client: any client records
